name: If convicted, what are the sentencing and appeal options?

mainEntity.name: If convicted, what are the sentencing and appeal options?

acceptedAnswer.text: Sentencing occurs after a conviction, with punishment scaling to the charges. You have the right to file motions for a new trial or appeal the verdict, challenging errors or unjust rulings. An attorney can review trial procedures for mistakes and advocate for reduced penalties.shouselaw+1​youtube​
